description: Step 1. Quote Monero (XMR) <-> native USDC on Arbitrum One; no account or API key. Creates no order. Quotes are estimates. Buy XMR ("get me 1 XMR"): {direction:"u2x", receiveAmount:"1"}. Sell XMR: {direction:"x2u", amount:"0.5"}. direction plus exactly one of amount (what the user sends) or receiveAmount (what they want). Pass to if known. Next: create_swap with next.arguments.

amount.description: What the user SENDS (x2u: XMR, u2x: USDC). Digits and one dot; no commas or units.

basis.description: receiveAmount met by the estimate (default) or the provider minimum (if published).

direction.description: Required. u2x: send USDC, get XMR. x2u: send XMR, get USDC.

receiveAmount.description: What the user wants to RECEIVE (u2x: XMR, x2u: USDC); needs direction.

requoteOf.description: Re-quote this quoteId's stored parameters; pass it alone.

to.description: Destination from the user: x2u an Arbitrum One 0x address, u2x a Monero address. Never guess.

name: get_quote
title: Get XMR/USDC swap quote
